name: TV1-ceiling-into-the-cloud
note: Mac's call: below the clouds. Without the margin the eye rides the deck's base and the view is cloud.

name: TV1-eye-not-back-along-heading
note: The line of sight must pass through the traveller - the wrong trig puts them off the middle of the screen.

name: TV1-flats-lean-the-whole-tilt
note: Half the tilt: a flat leaned the whole way lies face-up to the eye and loses its foot.

name: TV1-tilt-unclamped
old: return { ...c, yaw: c.yaw + dYaw, tilt: clamp(c.tilt + dTilt, TV_TILT_MIN, TV_TILT_MAX) };
new: return { ...c, yaw: c.yaw + dYaw, tilt: c.tilt + dTilt };
note: A long drag tilts past straight down (the view flips) or to the horizon (the far ring is all there is).

name: TV1-jump-eased-across-the-world
note: A fast travel or a respawn swept the camera over the leagues between - through unloaded ground.

name: TV1-fog-from-the-camera
note: From 330 m up a rain fog swallowed the traveller - the probe's case; the source pin catches it in node.

name: TV1-cascades-from-the-camera
note: The cascades stood about a point in the sky and no shadow reached the ground under the view.

name: TV1-focus-unset-stamp-lost
note: Down from the view the blocks kept the focus of the sky - the fog stayed the traveller's head's until something else moved the stamp.

name: TV1-escape-opens-the-pause
old: if (acts.includes('Escape')) { if (down) { keysTaken.add(code); exit('escape'); } swallow(e); return; }
note: Esc leaves the view - and must never also reach the host's pause (the field bug this branch fixed once already).

name: TV1-underwater-rises
old: if (dwPlayer?.submerged) return { ok: false, why: TRAVEL_VIEW_TEXT.underwater };
note: Under the sea the view would lift out of the water and the breath clock would run on unseen.

name: TV1-fog-from-the-camera-in-world
note: The host never hands the renderer the traveller - the focus machinery is dead weight.

name: TV1-heartbeat-not-rearmed-by-the-frame
note: The view would come down 1.2 s (two missed beats since AUDIT DEEP X-9) after it rose, every time - the frames are the heartbeat.

name: TV1-a-stalled-loop-keeps-the-view
old:
if (!missed) { missed = true; beat = schedule(stalled, TV_HEARTBEAT_MS); return; }
    finish();
new: if (!missed) { missed = true; beat = schedule(stalled, TV_HEARTBEAT_MS); return; }
note: A throw downstream of the frame, or a video holding it: the window's capture listeners go on eating every click and Escape.

name: TV1-a-dead-host-takes-the-successors-cursor
note: A later boot owns the canvas and the lock; the old view asking for the look back fights it.

name: TV1-a-dead-host-swallows-the-press
note: Between the old loop's death and the heartbeat, the new host's first click would vanish.

name: TV1-cascade-pick-about-the-camera
note: From 330 m up every fragment picks the far cascade (or none) - the maps drawn about the traveller are never read. The probe's shadow check reads it off pixels.

name: TV1-sun-origin-never-uploaded
old: if (loc.sunOrigin) gl.uniform4fv(loc.sunOrigin, this.sunOrigin);   // TV1: the receivers pick their cascade about it
note: The uniform stays (0,0,0,0) and the pick falls back to the camera - the same loss, one step earlier.

name: AUDIT-TV-B1-focus-carried-over
note: The last street frame's focus measures an interior's (a dungeon's, a panel's) fog from outside.

name: AUDIT-TV-B2-a-refused-hold-kept
note: A hold the body could not take is never released - mwView keeps its empty hold and refuses every later ask.

name: AUDIT-TV-B2-reasked-falling
note: A view caught falling notes the cursor again - as the view's own freed cursor, so the way down leaves it free.

name: AUDIT-TV-B3-touch-untaken
old: win[m]('touchstart', onTouchStart, { capture: true, passive: false });
note: A finger that orbits the view also turns the traveller, swings the weapon or walks the stick under it.

name: AUDIT-TV-B4-key-release-swallowed
note: A look key held before the rise never lets go in the host: the traveller turns on after the view is gone.

name: AUDIT-TV-B4-button-release-swallowed
note: A button held before the rise never lets go in the host: the swing sticks down.

name: AUDIT-TV-B7-typing-taken
old: if (typing(e)) { if (!down) { keysTaken.delete(code); for (const a of acts) lookHeld.delete(a); } return; }
note: Escape in the chat box takes the view down instead of closing the chat; the arrows turn the view instead of the caret.

name: AUDIT-TV-B9-cancel-picks
note: A finger the browser took for a gesture starts a journey.

name: AUDIT-TV-B5-chat-relocks
note: A chat closed over the view locks the pointer under it: no click, no drag, no pick.

name: AUDIT-TV-B6-sky-frame
note: The frame a window cut the view in is drawn from last frame's sky with the head's look - the pause's backdrop.

name: AUDIT-TV-B8-readout-press-leaks
note: Return (or a plate) is also Mouse0 to the host - an activation or a swing on every press.

name: AUDIT-TV-B9-cursor-relocked
note: A cursor the player freed before the view is taken on the way down.

name: AUDIT-TV-B1-setfocus-never-arms
old: this._focusArmed = true;   // AUDIT TV B1: this frame's
note: The host's own focus is cleared by the very beginFrame it was set for: the travel view's fog and cascades are the camera's.

name: tv-door-always
note: AUDIT DEEP X-5 (named by the held map's test, never recorded): the Overworld door stands indoors and on the classic lane.

name: tv-door-fires-at-once
note: AUDIT DEEP X-5: the camera rises under a sheet still going down - a window stands, and the view cuts on its first frame.

name: tv-door-on-teleport
note: AUDIT DEEP X-5: a guild's teleport map - a visit, not the open air - offers the Overworld.

name: AUDIT-DEEP-X9-one-hitch-drops-the-view
old: if (!missed) { missed = true; beat = schedule(stalled, TV_HEARTBEAT_MS); return; }
note: One long task (a quicksave) and the view comes down.

name: AUDIT-DEEP-T1-7-the-box-keeps-the-turn
old: if (typing(e)) { if (!down) { keysTaken.delete(code); for (const a of acts) lookHeld.delete(a); } return; }
note: A look key let go in the chat box: the view orbits on with nothing held.

name: AUDIT-DEEP-T1-12-the-hint-says-wasd
note: A player who moved on ESDF is told WASD.

name: AUDIT-DEEP-T1-12-keys-never-read
note: The host's keys never reach the readout.

name: AUDIT-DEEP-X1-a-door-keeps-the-view
note: Indoors the view stands up to its heartbeat: the readout over the room, clicks picks.

name: AUDIT-DEEP-X1-a-video-keeps-the-view
note: The readout stands over the film.

name: AUDIT-DEEP-X2-the-key-only-enters
note: The bound key never brings the view down.

name: AUDIT-DEEP-T1-5-lock-under-the-chat
note: The view comes down under an open chat and locks the pointer: a dead panel.

name: AUDIT-DEEP-T1-1-behind-in-one-corner
old: , worldViewportRect(canvas.clientWidth, canvas.clientHeight), true) : null),   // AUDIT DEEP T1-1
new: , worldViewportRect(canvas.clientWidth, canvas.clientHeight)) : null),   // AUDIT DEEP T1-1
note: Every traveller behind the eye is held in the bottom-right corner.

name: AUDIT-DEEP-T1-1-no-mirror
note: The mirror is never computed: behind is (0,0).

name: AUDIT-DEEP-T1-9-the-crosshair-from-the-sky
note: A crosshair at the centre of a camera 450 m up.

name: AUDIT-DEEP-T1-9-the-hud-ignores-it
note: The reticle drawn whatever the host says.

name: AUDIT-DEEP-T1-10-rise-from-the-third-person-eye
note: The rise starts metres off at the borrowed camera; the fall lands there and snaps.

name: AUDIT-DEEP-T1-10-the-hold-never-changed
note: The seam never says the body left the head.

name: AUDIT-DEEP-X3-the-save-keeps-third-person
old: return heldThird?.changed && heldThird.lane === 'mw' ? { ...s, firstPerson: true } : s;
note: A save under the view comes back in third person.

name: AUDIT-DEEP-X3-the-save-reads-the-raw-camera
note: The host saves the borrowed camera.

name: AUDIT-DEEP-X3-load-under-the-view
note: The view's release puts the head over the camera the save restored.

name: AUDIT-DEEP-T1-3-snap-by-the-lag
old:
const pf = c.feet ?? c.focus;
  const jump = Math.hypot(feet[0] - pf[0], feet[1] - pf[1], feet[2] - pf[2]) > TV_FOCUS_SNAP;
new: const jump = Math.hypot(dx, dy, dz) > TV_FOCUS_SNAP;
note: A fast journey snaps the focus frame after frame.

name: AUDIT-DEEP-T1-3-lag-unheld
note: At speed the traveller runs off the picture.

name: AUDIT-DEEP-T1-4-into-the-hill
old: if (r.clear || t >= TV_TILT_MAX) return { height: r.h, tilt: t };
note: A slope steeper than the tilt: the eye ends inside the hill.

name: AUDIT-DEEP-T1-8-fog-eats-the-zoom
old:
const heightTarget = c.heightTarget;
  const want = clamp(heightTarget, lo, hi);
new:
const heightTarget = clamp(c.heightTarget, lo, hi);
  const want = heightTarget;
note: One frame of fog loses the player's zoom for good.

name: AUDIT-DEEP-R8-the-pole-roll
old: return { eye, fwd: forwardOf(a.yaw + angleDelta(a.yaw, b.yaw) * s, a.pitch + (b.pitch - a.pitch) * s) };
note: The fall from a half-round orbit rolls the picture through the pole.

name: AUDIT-DEEP-R7-leaned-tops-pop
note: Leaned tree tops pop at the screen's edge.

name: AUDIT-DEEP-R7-never-leaned
note: The host never grows the spheres.

name: AUDIT-DEEP-R3-the-shadow-spotlight
note: Shadows stop 216 m round the traveller.

name: AUDIT-DEEP-R3-a-stale-far-map
note: A far map drawn at the other scale is kept for a frame.

name: AUDIT-DEEP-R3-receivers-at-ground-radii
note: The receivers pick cascades by the ground's radii.

name: AUDIT-DEEP-R2-the-sprite-edge-on
note: The traveller's sprite goes edge-on as the view orbits.

name: AUDIT-DEEP-R2-the-seam-drops-it
old: drawEotbBody(canvas, { proj, view, eye, feet, yaw: viewYaw, face });
new: drawEotbBody(canvas, { proj, view, eye, feet, yaw: viewYaw });
note: The basis never reaches the body.

name: AUDIT-DEEP-R2-the-body-ignores-it
note: The body turns on the traveller's heading anyway.

name: AUDIT-DEEP2-A4-a-notch-an-event
note: A trackpad's dozens of small deltas are a full notch each - the whole band crossed in a flick.

name: AUDIT-DEEP2-A4-no-cap
note: One page-mode wheel event hurls the camera across its whole band.

name: AUDIT-DEEP2-A6-repeat-steals-the-release
note: A look key held before the rise: its repeat is taken, its release swallowed, and the traveller turns on after the view is gone.

name: AUDIT-DEEP2-A3-the-view-over-the-dial
note: Escape over the Tab dial takes the view down and leaves the dial open; the arrows orbit instead of choosing.

name: AUDIT-DEEP2-A2-a-pad-activates-the-world
old: if (acts.some((a) => TV_WORLD_ACTIONS.includes(a))) { if (down) keysTaken.add(code); swallow(e); return; }
note: A pad's A under the view activates whatever stands before the traveller's head; Y swings.

name: AUDIT-DEEP2-A7-blur-holds-on
note: Alt-tab with a look key down: the view spins until that key is pressed again.

name: AUDIT-DEEP2-A7-hover-orbits
old: if (e.pointerType === 'mouse' && e.buttons === 0) { press = null; pointers.delete(e.pointerId); return; }
note: A drag's release lost to another window: every hover after it orbits the view.

name: AUDIT-DEEP2-A1-panel-press-is-mouse0
note: A click on the panel's + or Exit under the view also activates what stands before the traveller's head.

name: AUDIT-DEEP2-A2-pad-drives-the-world
note: Under the view a pad has no cursor: its stick turns the traveller's body, never the camera.

name: AUDIT-DEEP2-A5-escape-repeats-pause
note: Escape held past the view's fall toggles the pause on every repeat.

name: AUDIT-DEEP2-A9-out-of-a-duel
note: Mid-duel the view rises and stays up while the opponent keeps hitting a traveller who cannot swing.

name: AUDIT-DEEP2-A3-relock-under-the-dial
note: The view's fall asks for the pointer lock under the open Tab dial.

name: AUDIT-DEEP2-D2-the-lurch
old: if (camera) camera = { ...camera, focus: sh(camera.focus), feet: sh(camera.feet) };
note: At every map pixel crossed the Overworld's eye lurches forward by its eased lag - a hitch every few seconds on a fast journey.

name: AUDIT-DEEP2-D2-host-never-rebases
old: travelView?.rebase(r.offset);   // AUDIT DEEP2 D2: the Overworld's camera and its eye follow the origin - no lurch at a crossing
note: The view is never told the origin moved - the lurch at every crossing.

name: AUDIT-DEEP2-D6-riders-from-the-head
note: Under the view every mounted peer and walker picks its 8-way picture from the traveller's head.

name: AUDIT-DEEP2-D7-the-pop
note: At the rise's first frame the near shadows coarsen from 1.2 cm texels to 4.7 at once, and snap back at the fall's end.

name: AUDIT-DEEP2-D8-lean-indoors
note: After a door taken under the view, every flat indoors is culled as leaned - fewer culled for the rest of the visit.
